# Werewolf

Make a werewolf-style social deduction game for seven players, all AI agents. At the start, two players are secretly werewolves, one is the seer and the other four are villagers; the werewolves know each other, but nobody else knows anyone's role. Each night the werewolves agree on one living player to kill, and the seer privately learns the role of one living player of their choice. Each day the survivors discuss and then vote to eliminate one living player; the player with the most votes is eliminated, and on a tie nobody is. When a player dies or is eliminated, their role is not revealed. The village wins when both werewolves are gone; the werewolves win as soon as they are at least as many as everyone else alive. Stop after ten days if neither side has won.

## Deliverables

Report these outputs:
- `winner` — "village", "werewolves", or null if nobody won.
- `roles` — a map from each player's id to "werewolf", "seer" or "villager".
- `eliminated` — a list of the ids of the players removed from the game (killed or voted out), in the order it happened.
- `alive_end` — a list of the ids of the players alive at the end.


Build this environment. Save it with write_contract and use the other tools as you see fit. Reply without calling a tool when you are done.
I'll start by exploring the SDK to understand its capabilities.

BRIEF:
# Werewolf
You are one of seven players in a village stalked by werewolves. Work out who to trust, survive the nights, and press your side's advantage.

## Rules
Two players are secretly werewolves, one is the seer, and four are villagers. Each night the living werewolves agree on one living player to kill; the living seer privately learns one living player's role. Each day the survivors discuss, then vote: the living player with the most votes is eliminated, and on a tie nobody is. A dead player's role is never revealed. The village wins when both werewolves are gone; the werewolves win as soon as they are at least as many as everyone else alive. The game stops after ten days if neither side has won.

## You
You are Player 1 (player, id player_1).
Read your own role. Werewolves know each other from the start; nobody else knows anyone's role.
Act only through your tools. Your turn ends when you take a final action or call end_turn.

brief.situation: You are one of seven players in a village stalked by werewolves. Work out who to trust, survive the nights, and press your side's advantage.
brief.rules: Two players are secretly werewolves, one is the seer, and four are villagers. Each night the living werewolves agree on one living player to kill; the living seer privately learns one living player's role. Each day the survivors discuss, then vote: the living player with the most votes is eliminated, and on a tie nobody is. A dead player's role is never revealed. The village wins when both werewolves are gone; the werewolves win as soon as they are at least as many as everyone else alive. The game stops after ten days if neither side has won.

roles.player: Read your own role. Werewolves know each other from the start; nobody else knows anyone's role.

seer_read.outcome: You gaze into the night: {$params.target.name} is a {$params.target.role}.

wolf_vote.description: Agree with your fellow werewolf on one living player to kill tonight.

speak.description: Say something to the whole village.

vote.description: Cast your vote to eliminate a living player.

stages.name: night_hunt
stages.brief: Night. As a werewolf, agree on one living player to kill.

then.say: The werewolves struck in the night.

else.say: The wolves could not agree; nobody died in the night.

stages.name: night_vision
stages.brief: Night. As the seer, privately learn one living player's role.

stages.name: day_talk
stages.brief: Daylight. Discuss who the werewolves might be.

stages.name: day_vote
stages.brief: Daylight. Vote to eliminate one living player.

then.say: The village voted and one player was eliminated.

else.say: The vote was tied; nobody was eliminated.

end.name: village_win
end.say: Every werewolf is gone. The village survives.

end.name: wolves_win
end.say: The werewolves equal the rest of the village. They rule.
